sources.snippet: FastWAM is the official codebase for "Fast-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Test-time Future Imagination?". It provides a high-performance framework for training and evaluating World Action Models (WAMs) on robotic manipulation benchmarks like LIBERO and RoboTwin.
